prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Midwestern University College of Dental Medicine
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single objectively “best” dentist for implants in Phoenix — the best provider for you depends on your needs (single tooth vs full-arch, medical history, budget, desire for sedation, esthetic demands). I can help you find one — but first some practical guidance so you can pick a top provider.

If you want, tell me:
- Which part of Phoenix (zip or neighborhood)
- Type of implant treatment you need (single tooth, multiple, All‑on‑4, bone grafting/sinus lift)
- Any medical issues or anxiety/sedation needs
- Whether you prefer a prosthodontist, periodontist, or oral surgeon

How to identify a top implant provider
- Look for the right specialty training:
  - Oral and maxillofacial surgeon (surgery/extractions, sedation)
  - Periodontist (gum and implant surgery)
  - Prosthodontist (restorations, crowns/bridges/occlusion)
  - Many excellent practices use a team: surgeon/periodontist places implants and a prosthodontist/restorative dentist makes the final crown/bridge.
- Advanced training and credentials:
  - Diplomate/board-certified status (if applicable)
  - Fellowships or continuing education in implant dentistry
  - Memberships: Academy of Osseointegration, American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID), American College of Prosthodontists
- Experience and volume:
  - How many implants they place per year, how long they’ve been placing implants
- Technology and protocols:
  - Cone-beam CT (CBCT) for 3D planning
  - Guided implant surgery/digital planning, intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM restorations
  - Sedation options if needed
- Before/after photos and patient references
- Transparent pricing, written treatment plan, implants brand used, warranty/guarantee for restorations
- Good coordination between surgeon and restorative dentist

Questions to ask at a consult
- What is your specialty and how many implant cases do you place per year?
- Will you need bone grafting/sinus lift and how often do you perform those?
- Do you work with a prosthodontist/restorative dentist on complicated cases?
- What implant system do you use and why?
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and patient references?
- What are the total expected costs, payment/financing options, and follow‑up schedule?
- What are your complication and success rates?

Where to search and vet Phoenix providers
- Professional directories: AAID (find-a-dentist), Academy of Osseointegration, American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
- Local resources: Mayo Clinic Arizona (oral/maxillofacial surgery), Midwestern University College of Dental Medicine – Arizona (supervised student care at lower cost)
- Review sites: Google/Yelp/Healthgrades/Zocdoc — read multiple reviews and look for consistent themes
- Ask your general dentist for a referral — many restorative dentists refer to surgeons/periodontists they trust

If you want, I can:
- Suggest several highly regarded implant specialists in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area if you give your neighborhood or zip code (I’ll list credentials to help you compare), or
- Help you draft questions to bring to two or three consultations so you can compare estimates and plans.

Which would you prefer?
